h2o-concentration-sign.problem: F3: the H2O initial-concentration polynomial has only positive coefficients, 55.93 M at 25 degC and rising with T, while water density falls with T (about 55.35 M at 25 degC).
h2o-concentration-sign.solution: Trace the coefficients to their source, fix the sign or variable (K vs degC), add a test at 4, 25 and 80 degC, and regenerate goldens with approval.

g-value-dose-rate-range.problem: F2: GValuesBoscolo._scale_factor (variable_GValues) has no valid dose-rate range, no clamp and is inf at 0 Gy/s.
g-value-dose-rate-range.solution: Document the fitted dose-rate range, clamp or raise ValueError outside it and reject non-positive dose rates.

timer-next-off-nan.problem: F4: Timer.time_till_next_OFF returns NaN for continuous timers (period = inf: inf * 0 in _phase).
timer-next-off-nan.solution: Return time - start_time as phase when the period is infinite and add tests for constant and single-pulse timers.

result-persistence-gaps.problem: F7, F8, F6, F12: burst_dose_rates is not persisted to HDF5, reconstruct_reactions ignores use_beam=False, parse_dataset_name uses .strip('.sim') (characters, not suffix), and old files keep a doubled catalase k_value.
result-persistence-gaps.solution: Record use_beam and burst_dose_rates in the json config (optional keys, fallback for old files), pass beam=None to reaction_rates when use_beam is False, use removesuffix('.sim'), and add a format version to handle old enzymatic k_value.

simenv-make-hash.problem: F5: SimEnv.make_hash always raises TypeError (unhashable species_order dict) and hashes repr(frozenset), which depends on PYTHONHASHSEED.
simenv-make-hash.solution: Hash a canonical json serialisation (sort_keys) of parameters and initial concentrations, or remove the unused method.

macro-chunked-golden.problem: F10: no golden output for a chunked run with MacroPulsedBeam.
macro-chunked-golden.solution: Add a short chunked macro run to tests/golden/record_golden.py and compare by label with the existing tolerances.

minor-cleanups.problem: F11, F13, F14: temperature leftovers (iter_*_kvalues default 25 degC, convert_to_config_dict), UnitCell API traps (set_beam LET=None, run_till_max_dose t_span, intervals[-2] IndexError) and ruff format would reformat 34 files.
minor-cleanups.solution: Pass the env temperature in ReactionsList, write polynomial coefficients in convert_to_config_dict, make the UnitCell traps explicit (log/raise), and do one dedicated ruff format commit with .gitattributes line endings.

refresh-example-notebook.problem: Notebook check: examples/notebook_basic_usage.ipynb cell 19 passes max_dose positionally to PulsedBeam.from_dose_rate_peak (it lands in n_pulse; the 10 Gy total matches by coincidence); cells 25 and 27 hold a corrupted µ sign; stored outputs predate the refactor.
refresh-example-notebook.solution: Through the Jupyter MCP tools: use max_dose= in cell 19, fix the µ sign, re-run the notebook and save fresh outputs.
